integrity.degree_formula_basis: The classical Harris--Tu symmetric determinantal degree product is reproduced in Nie--Ranestad--Sturmfels, Proposition 14.
integrity.first_public_date_basis: arXiv:1508.01995 version 1 is timestamped 2015-08-09 and is categorized in Algebraic Geometry.
integrity.primary_slot_basis: The archival anchor is explicitly an Algebraic Geometry paper on symmetric determinantal loci.
integrity.proof_basis: Prime-primary unit witnesses are proved directly from Legendre floor sums; the power-of-two branch is proved from the adjacent-corank ratio and a binary digit-sum inequality.

scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns projective degrees of complex symmetric determinantal loci in their standard projective embedding.
Generic nonsymmetric and skew-symmetric rank loci are not covered.
The result determines the common gcd of the rank tower but not all prime-adic valuations of every individual degree.
An older weakly indexed source could contain the same arithmetic consequence of the classical degree product.
title: Exact gcd of the symmetric determinantal rank tower
